messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Respiratory depression.
Gabapentin can cause life-threatening breathing problems.
These breathing problems are called respiratory depression.
Respiratory depression is especially likely if you already have a breathing disorder.
COPD is an example of a breathing disorder.
Respiratory depression is especially likely if you are elderly.
Respiratory depression is especially likely if you use other medicines that can make you drowsy or slow your breathing.
Opioids are examples of medicines that can make you drowsy or slow your breathing.
CNS depressants are examples of medicines that can make you drowsy or slow your breathing.
Seek emergency medical attention if you have very slow breathing.
Suicidal thoughts or behaviors.
Some people have thoughts about suicide while taking and after discontinuing Gabapentin.
Stay alert to changes in your mood or symptoms.
Tell your doctor right away if you have any sudden changes in mood or behavior, or thoughts about suicide.
Abrupt or rapid discontinuation.
Seizures may occur if you stop using gabapentin suddenly.
Triplet: ["COPD", "is example of", "breathing disorder"]

The relation 'is example of' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject entity is an example or instance of the category or class specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'include': The object entity is a type or example of the subject entity.
B. 'is one of most widely prescribed': The subject entity is among the most commonly prescribed entities of the type specified by the object entity.
C. 'is defined as': The subject condition or entity is defined by the description specified by the object entity.
D. 'contribute to': The subject entity plays a role in the development or occurrence of the object entity.
E. 'related to': The subject entity is associated with or connected to the medical condition or entity specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
